pages.title: Made to Order
pages.text: Every naturally spawned character has a bed of her own; a character without one vanishes where the player cannot see. Players cannot use a character bed, nor set their spawn point on one.

$(bold)What it is for$()$(br)Inside a structure, the bed is the character's spawn point; even if she is lost or dies by accident, she will revive on this bed.$(br2)$(bold)Placing$()$(br)But be warned: any attempt to move the bed may make it fail, so do not move it at will, or the character may be wiped.
